prediction_vs_result.prediction: Written before the capture. (1) The prefixes reproduce: each of the five, generated natively on GPU0 by today's recorder, writes the 135 tokens of its historical screening answer and makes the historical decision at step 135. The historical margins there are small (0.01 and 0.07 in the wrong cases, 0.15, 0.41 and 0.15 in the successful ones) and the recorder has been rebuilt since the registered answers were recorded, so this can fail; then the case is reported as it is and the rows are read through the first step at which the five differ. (2) Before the first prompt position at which two cases' tokens differ, the pair's states are equal at every merge. (3) No jump between the kinds in how far apart the states are: at the row of the decision, in the joint reading, the cross pair 12/16 lies nearer together than the successful pair 16/24, which has twice its loss difference, at more than half of the 105 merges. How far apart two of the five are follows their losses, not their kind. (4) The recurring difference does part them: along what the registered wrong answers have in common, at the row of the decision (registered at place 148, where 460c3ebb read the left-out difference in 0.89 to 1.00 of the pairs from layer 6), both wrong cases lie over all three successful ones at more than half of the merges of layers 6 to 34; and at the rows before the decision they do so at fewer merges, in the mean over those rows, than at the row of the decision.

That order includes the order inside each kind: loss 12 over loss 11 among the wrong cases, and loss 24 over 16 over 20 among the successful ones, which the losses themselves do not give (the order of the losses holds at 0 merges). At the 149 rows before the decision the same order holds at a mean 0.62 merges (one order of 120: 0.72 if every order were as likely), at most 11 (step 30); 0 rows reach 33, and no row's median rank correlation is as high (0.90 at the row of the decision; over the rows before, mean 0.031 and greatest 0.70). Over all 120 orders and every row before (17880 combinations), 3 hold at as many merges and the greatest is 39. Two limits. In the last layers the scores are computed from the state, so that some direction orders the five by their decisions there is given; what is not given is that it is this direction, made from 27 other wrong answers and a reference none of the five is in, and that it does so from feedforward-19. And feedforward-19 is where the order first appears in these five cases: it is read from them, not known beforehand. The scores are read here as a description of five cases; they are no objective, selector or stopping criterion.

They carry nearly as much: medians 0.01118, 0.01083, 0.01192 against 0.01179 and 0.01221, and they lie at 0.492, 0.466, 0.519 of the way from a registered correct answer to a registered wrong one, the wrong cases at 0.528 and 0.540. Astra's specification named another: a distinction absent beyond same-kind variation at comparable numeric differences. In size it is absent: the kinds' means differ by 0.00052 and the three successful cases range over 0.00126. What remains is the order at the row of the decision.

failures_only.five_answers_of_one_question: Five answers to one question that differ in one number (m 3, v 8, drop 1, rise 1; losses 11, 12, 16, 20, 24), one decision, one place of the registration. failures_only.the_unregistered_cases_have_no_registrat: The three unregistered cases' rows are read at the places the two registered cases' rows are registered at. Their text is the same token for token before the decision, so the rows correspond; the registration itself was never run on them.

The two agree where they overlap (a left-out wrong answer 0.02426 there, the builders 0.02234 here), and the map's per-answer readings are of the raw state while this read's are of the joint features, so the raw shares and the joint shares are each compared only with their own kind.

what_this_changes.what_was_observed: At the same answer text the five answers' states do not part by kind at any row: how far apart two of them lie follows the question's number. Along the recurring direction the row of the decision is where they part: there, from feedforward-19 on, they lie in the order of their own decisions, the order inside each kind included; at the 149 rows before it that order appears as often as chance gives it (one earlier row reaches the count of prediction 4, none the order). For this decision that is where the wrong and the right computation are told apart once the text is the same: the row that decides, from feedforward-19. Before it nothing read here tells the kinds apart.
what_this_changes.what_it_says_about_the_recurring_differe: The recurring difference is real and specific in the cohort: at this place a left-out wrong answer lies over a left-out correct answer that writes the same token at 0.993 of the pairs and merges, and a correct answer of a wrong answer's own m, v and drop carries 0.023 of its reading in the median. And an answer can carry nearly as much of it as a wrong answer to its own question and still decide the right way: the three successful cases, which follow the wrong answers' text to the decision, lie at 0.492, 0.466, 0.519 of the way to a registered wrong answer, their wrong siblings at 0.528 and 0.540. What separates the two kinds among answers that carry it is 0.047 of the wrong cases' distance from the correct reference (0.137 from feedforward-19 on).
what_this_changes.for_the_correction_objective_astras_to_j: This is my reading, offered to the objective's owner and decided by nothing here. A request that moves a wrong answer's state at this place the whole way to the registered correct reference asks the weights for the part that successful answers on the same text carry too, and in these five that is all but 0.047 of it (0.137 from feedforward-19 on). The part that goes with the wrong decision is small, sits at the deciding row and first shows at feedforward-19. Marcos's words of November 12, that the training should know where the overlap exists and that nothing should apply where the computation already agrees, have a concrete reading in these five: the rows before the decision, and at the decision the layers before the order appears. Whether a target should be read against answers on the same path rather than against the nearest mixture of registered correct answers is the question this raises; the same-text pool holds only these five, and no number here selects a model, a ridge, a dose or a threshold.
what_this_changes.what_it_does_not_change: No model was made and no target, mask or threshold. The frozen reference and the cohort are as they were; the three unregistered cases stay outside them, and the no-fit case was recorded again from the original model for this reading only and is not untouched data for any later evaluation. Repair and transfer are established by the earlier edits and are not reopened by five prefixes.
